title: UI foundation root checkpoint: full chronology, released routing and proof identity

reviews.classification: Full chronological UI root/checkpoint; dated current labels and later actual receipts qualified
reviews.disposition:
F1. Complete278-line read covers the Oct18 router, Oct16 reconciliation, M2/R12/R11 handoffs, shell/C1/S1–S3 histories, original S1 evidence/next steps, later S1/S2 technical closes and final R14 triage. Current routing within this historical file already says older single-writer/next-round sections are chronology. Oct18 UIL8 ownership is also dated, not a current live reservation. No PID, server link or old no-worker line was probed here or treated as present process state; do not restart a server, old next round or handoff from those paragraphs. Current project/accepted-direction/runtime owners govern selected work, and this content reconciliation grants no source reservation.

F2. Preserve chronological verification rather than overwrite it: initial S1 browser reruns were later explicitly closed, and Q6 was clarified as an unobvious route rather than a missing one. Incidental crafting overlap is a different reproduced defect. S1/S2/S3, C1, shell and R3/R12/R14 counts have different input identities and overlapping focused subsets, not a cumulative test total. The clean export1773pass/zero fail/threeTODO M2/R14 lineage does not repair the dirty continuation/clock suite. Contract exceptions469/638 shrinking toward211/273 is scoped literal-style accounting, not proof all UI behavior or all UR21–UR33 routes were covered. AD36/AD43 retain those distinctions.

F3. Source/served parity and frozen images authenticate the stated captured candidate only. C1's Normal/revealed reference and later DEV SEEDED comparisons have separate provenance. Paused inspection preservation is not a claim running game time stops when a panel opens. S2's150% viewport emulation was explicitly not real browser zoom. Exact browser layout keys/pins/collapse and gameplay save schema have different owners, so save/import checks do not make all presentation preferences portable game state. Current14/21px desktop/prose-first/optional-art direction qualifies old CJK defaults,1366-first grids and literal footer placement without discarding useful source-fit history.

F4. Later full reports in B249–B251 qualify the old future statuses: inventory tabs, status home and later crowded-log/UI composition have technical receipts; old source-only missing claims are not blanket current absence. R21c's passing leak result is qualified by R22b/c's later dormant-export leak, and hand-toggled fight return/undiscovered Stances are not natural browser proof. The useful shared center/panel/navigation APIs remain existing-owner routes, not permission for another mover/save owner. The actual old M2 commit is recorded history, not authorization to commit this reconciliation. Under AD32 proposals remain proposals; AD42 keeps human taste optional. No linked private source, runtime, browser, user save, commit or installation proof was freshly established.
reviews.evidence: Entire278-line input delivered in ranges1–145,146–278. No PID/server check, linked private source, image or runtime test renewed.
reviews.reopen: Selected current UI ownership/input change; use actual current owner rather than old next/reservation/PID. Preserve exact chronology and proof limits.
